name: ClickSyncr for MailerLite – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms & Formidable
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for MailerLite connects your forms to MailerLite, so every form submission becomes a subscriber in your MailerLite group: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one MailerLite connection. Configure each form right inside the builder you already use.

Stop copying and pasting emails between your website and your email marketing. Map your form fields to MailerLite once, and ClickSyncr keeps your audience growing on autopilot every time someone fills out a form.

“MailerLite” is a trademark of MailerLite Limited. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by MailerLite Limited.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your MailerLite API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your groups load automatically: choose which MailerLite group new subscribers join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any field: send names, phone numbers, and MailerLite fields straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds subscribers as Active when they tick it, or Unconfirmed when they don’t.
  • Subscriber status control: choose Active, Unconfirmed, or defer to your MailerLite account’s double opt-in setting, per form.
  • No duplicate subscribers: existing subscribers are updated and new ones are added, every single time.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different group with its own field mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every configured form’s sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent, and to which group.

Learn more about the forms to MailerLite integration.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr MailerLite settings (a tab, panel, or feed, depending on your builder).
  3. Paste your MailerLite API key. Your groups and subscriber fields load instantly, and the connection is shared across builders.
  4. Choose a group and map your form fields to MailerLite fields (email is required).
  5. Optionally pick a consent field so subscribers opt in when they tick it.
  6. Save. Every submission now syncs to MailerLite automatically.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A MailerLite account with an API key

Getting your MailerLite API key

  1. Log in to your MailerLite account.
  2. Go to Integrations > API (or open MailerLite → Integrations → API).
  3. Generate a new API token.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr MailerLite tab.

Support

Need a hand? Visit clicksyncr.com and we’ll be glad to help.

External service: MailerLite

This plugin connects to MailerLite, the email marketing service, to sync your form submissions with your MailerLite account.

When data is sent: when you connect your API key, when your groups and fields load in the form editor, and when a visitor submits a form you’ve configured with ClickSyncr. At that point their form data (email and any mapped fields) is sent to MailerLite.

What is sent: your MailerLite API key (to authenticate), the subscriber’s email address and any fields you choose to map, and the group you select.

By using this plugin you agree to MailerLite’s Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with applicable data-protection laws (such as GDPR) and for obtaining consent from your visitors before their data is collected and sent to MailerLite.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for MailerLite”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Make sure at least one supported form builder is installed and activated.
  2. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr MailerLite settings.
  3. Follow the on-screen setup. Full guidance is on the ClickSyncr for MailerLite page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a MailerLite account?

Yes. You’ll need an active MailerLite account and an API key to sync your subscribers.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my MailerLite API key?

Log in to MailerLite and go to Integrations > API, then generate a new API token.

Can I map custom fields?

Yes. Map any form field to your MailerLite subscriber fields, including your account’s custom fields.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the subscriber is added as Active (opted-in); if they leave it unticked, they’re added as Unconfirmed instead. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Does it work with MailerLite double opt-in?

Yes. Choose “Use MailerLite account setting” as the subscriber status and MailerLite decides: with double opt-in enabled, new subscribers get a confirmation email and become Active when they confirm.

Will it create duplicate subscribers?

No. If a subscriber already exists, ClickSyncr updates them. If not, it adds a new one, and it never removes a subscriber from groups they’re already in.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr MailerLite setup, so each can sync to a different group.
